$comment: GENERATED by mcp-server/cmd/schemagen from the Go types; do not edit. Run make gen.
description: Lists the completed matches in a league that kicked off in [from, to), with final scores and a one-line recap, in kickoff order. Ranges are at most 32 days.

from.description: Start of the range, inclusive: an RFC 3339 time, such as 2026-10-11T23:00:00Z

league.description: League code from list_competitions, such as eng.1

sport.description: Sport id from list_competitions, such as football

to.description: End of the range, exclusive: an RFC 3339 time

name: find_matches

end_estimate.description: Estimated finish, RFC 3339 UTC: the source gives start times only

final_result.description: Canonical result line, such as Brentford 1–2 Liverpool; empty until the match is completed

id.description: Source match id, passed to get_match_events

name.description: Full display name, such as Brentford

role.description: home or away; empty where a sport has neither

score.description: Final or current score, as the source writes it

short_name.description: Short display name, such as Spurs

winner.description: True for the winner of a completed match; false for both sides in a draw

status.description: scheduled, in_progress, completed or other (postponed, abandoned)

summary.description: One-line recap from the source; may be empty

title.description: Home v away, such as Brentford v Liverpool
